note: Language versions that are built but not ready to be indexed (machine-obvious or incomplete translations). Each listed page gets <meta name="robots" content="noindex, follow">, and is left out of hreflang links (on every language version of the page) and of sitemap.xml. Keys are language codes; values are English page paths ("/tools/loan-emi-calculator/", "/", "/category/text/") or "*" for every page in that language. Remove an entry once the translation has been reviewed. scripts/i18n.js reads this file.
